title: The Club Improvement Cycle
description: Given a session outcome, the learner traces how it becomes a post-event note, accumulates in a lessons-learned log, and eventually produces a club evolution decision.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club

educational.audience: Coding club leaders, mentors, and student officers

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a session outcome, the learner traces how it becomes a post-event note, accumulates in a lessons-learned log, and eventually produces a club evolution decision.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Step-through worked example with concrete data visible at every stage
pedagogical.assessment: Give a new Stage 1 observation and ask the learner to produce the Stage 2 note and state what must be true before it justifies a Stage 4 change.
